entities.summary: Raymonde Peschard was an Algerian social worker and freedom fighter during the Algerian War of Independence. She was first a member of the Algerian Communist Party but joined the National Liberation Army after she was incorrectly accused of planning the Milk Bar Café bombing with Zohra Drif. While a member of the ALN, she adopted the codename "الطاووس," meaning peacock in Arabic.
